stem:
Meera's father buys batteries for the torch used during power cuts at their home in Pune. He wants to know which battery can be recharged and reused many times instead of being thrown away after one use.
Which statement correctly classifies a battery as rechargeable?

options.text: A battery is rechargeable if it gives a large current the first time it is used.
A battery is rechargeable if it can be connected to a charger and used again for many cycles.
A battery is rechargeable if it is small and light enough to fit inside a torch.
A battery is rechargeable if it stops working completely after one use.

teacher.key_rationale: A rechargeable (secondary) battery is defined by its ability to be recharged and reused over multiple cycles, unlike a single-use dry cell. Only option B states this defining condition; A confuses it with current output, C with size, and D describes a single-use cell.
